english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for praising someone or something very highly and lavishly.
Use this when showing enthusiasm specifically by praising something or someone enthusiastically.

examples.english: The customers heap praise on our dishes after eating and say they will definitely come again.
examples.traditional: 客人食完之後大讚我哋啲菜，仲話一定會再嚟。
examples.jyutping: haak3 jan4 sik6 jyun4 zi1 hau6 daai6 zaan3 ngo5 dei6 di1 coi3 zung6 waa6 jat1 ding6 wui5 zoi3 lai4

examples.english: Everyone began to enthuse about this film, saying it was very thoughtfully made.
examples.traditional: 大家都大讚呢套戲，話拍得好有心思。
examples.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 daai6 zaan3 ni1 tou3 hei3 waa6 paak3 dak1 hou2 jau5 sam1 si1
